edition.positioning: Single Lap Comrades and Totalsports Two Oceans Marathon qualifier

entries.manualEntryNote: Manual entries available at collection points only (not on race day), subject to availability. No entries on race day.

qualifiers.cutoffCaveat: The race cut-off is 6h30. The qualifying standard for both Comrades and Two Oceans is 4:59:59 — finishing inside the cut-off does not mean you have qualified.

comrades.name: Comrades Marathon 2027
comrades.ballotNote: The Comrades general ballot closes 22 September 2026 — the same day MadMac's online entries close.

twoOceans.name: Totalsports Two Oceans Marathon 2027
twoOceans.seedingNote: A marathon qualifying time is also used for seeding at Two Oceans.

qualifiers.singleLapNote: Single lap, no repeated loops — the marathon does not repeat a circuit, though the course does include out-and-back sections.

course.measurementNote: Course distances are computed from the official GPX exports. Elevation follows Strava's terrain model rather than a survey, so treat vertical figures as indicative.
course.r59CrossingNote: The 11km, 22km and 42.2km all cross the R59 (Sybrand van Niekerk Freeway) at the Karee Road / Randvaal Road crossing.

distances.label: 42.2km
distances.profileSummary: The first 20km rolls gently between 1 470m and 1 520m, with the low point around 16km. The only meaningful climb comes between 20km and 24km, gaining about 70m, steepest in the two kilometres to 24km. From 24km to 40km it's rolling at 1 510–1 550m, then it drops away over the final two kilometres into the finish.
distances.routeDescription: Starts in Daleside, with a long eastern out-and-back along Karee Road, a western section crossing the R59 into the Randvaal smallholding grid around 3rd to 5th Road, and loops through Daleside village itself.

distances.label: 22km
distances.profileSummary: Climbs about 66m in the first 4km, rolls at altitude through the middle, then descends from 20km to the finish — front-loaded rather than flat.
distances.routeDescription: Heads west from Daleside, crosses the R59, and runs a rectangular loop through the smallholding grid between 2nd and 8th Road before returning.

distances.label: 11km
distances.profileSummary: About 70–90m of ascent, one rise in the first half, descent home. Carries a 10km timing point.
distances.routeDescription: Crosses the R59 west from Daleside and runs a single loop through the closer-in Randvaal streets around Rolbos, Groenbos and Fynbos, then returns. It does not reach the numbered-road grid the 22km uses, making it the most suburban of the longer distances.

distances.label: 5km
distances.profileSummary: Effectively pancake flat — 13m of total vertical spread across the whole distance. Exactly what a first-timer or a parent with a nine-year-old wants to hear.
distances.routeDescription: A compact loop inside Daleside village around Karee Road, Morris Street and Kroonarend Street. Genuinely family-friendly, close to the venue.

prizeMoney.equalGenderStatement: Men's and women's prize money is equal across every distance and every category.
prizeMoney.paymentNote: Prizes paid electronically, by EFT within seven days, unless WADA testing results are pending.

perks.tshirt: Rainbow gradient (green → yellow → orange) with MadMac branding front, sponsor wall back.
perks.medal: Silver, distance-stamped (42.2KM / 22KM etc.) on a blue ribbon. Note: the 42.2km medal is issued at the finish, not at any intermediate point — there is no separate 21km medal.

platoOffer.condition: Show your finisher medal on 4 October. Valid that day only, at that branch only.

raceRules.timing: Mat-to-mat chip timing with checkpoints on route.
raceRules.governingBodies: Run under WA, ASA and AVT rules.
raceRules.licenceNote: ASA-affiliated runners must wear their licence number front and back. Non-affiliated runners need a temporary licence at additional cost and must run in neutral or white colours — required for the 42.2km, 22km and 11km, not the 5km.
raceRules.prohibited: No seconding, no dogs, no pets, no headphones (unless required by organisers), no cyclists.
raceRules.ageCategoryNote: Age categories determined as at date of competition; proof of age and ID required at prize giving.
raceRules.appeals: Referee's decision final; appeals require a form and a R500 deposit, refunded if successful.

faq.q: Is MadMac an approved Comrades and Two Oceans qualifier?
faq.a: MadMac is positioned and marketed as a single-lap Comrades and Totalsports Two Oceans Marathon qualifier, and has carried that status in previous editions. Written confirmation of the 2027 approved-qualifier listing for both races is being obtained — check back closer to race day if this matters to your entry decision.

faq.q: What time do I need to run to qualify?
faq.a: Under 4:59:59 for the 42.2km, for both the Comrades centenary and Two Oceans 2027. That's the qualifying standard, not MadMac's own 6h30 cut-off — see the qualifier panel above.

faq.q: Can I enter on race day?
faq.a: No. Manual entries are available at the collection points listed above, subject to availability, but there is no entry on race day itself.
No, cancellations aren't allowed. This is a Race Pass entry-terms policy, not a MadMac-specific one — see Race Pass's own terms for the full detail.

faq.q: Can I substitute my entry to another person?
faq.a: Yes, substitutions are allowed up to 20 days before race day, from your Race Pass "My races" page.

faq.q: Can I transfer my entry to another race?
faq.a: Yes, transfers to another race are allowed up to 20 days before race day, from your Race Pass "My races" page.

faq.q: Where do I collect my race number?
faq.a: Five points across Johannesburg and the Vaal in race week, plus the venue itself — see the number collection table above. A Postnet-to-Postnet delivery option is also available through Race Pass.

faq.q: How will I find my race number?
faq.a: Race Pass publishes a race-number lookup closer to race day, linked from your entry confirmation.
